about: The owner's verdicts on our own exports, the ground truth for lib/tastegate.mjs (node studio.mjs taste calibrate). Exports live on the owner's machine (out/<film>/takeNN, not in git); rows whose file is missing are skipped. 'about' says what the verdict judged: picture verdicts calibrate the picture metrics; sound verdicts are kept for the future audio gate. Add a row every time the owner accepts or rejects a take.
